## Per-target APIs

| Target | Manifest | Output | Files |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| [SVQC](serverqc/index.md) | `src/serverqc/serverqc.src` | `data/progs.dat` | 254 |
| [CSQC](clientqc/index.md) | `src/clientqc/clientqc.src` | `data/csprogs.dat` | 33 |
